Harbour Notes 12 March 2026

The Lighthouse Keeper's Log

For one hundred years the light on Gull Point burned every night, and the keeper wrote down everything he saw.

What the log says

The entries are short. Weather, ships, oil levels, and once in a while a line about the gulls.

  • Fog on the 3rd, two ships passed close to the shoal
  • Lamp trimmed at dusk, wick replaced on the 9th
  • A pod of dolphins followed the ferry for a mile

A sample entry

14 March. Clear at dawn. One trawler in, two out.
Oil low - ordered more by letter.
